usedFor: Email activity in Mailjet, such as “Email Link Clicked”, adds people to HubSpot through “Create Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “Email Link Clicked” in Mailjet, then “Create Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A click is a sign of interest, and the action creates a HubSpot contact from the properties you give it.

watchOut: “Create Contact” requires an email, so a “New Email Blocked” or “Email Sent” run needs an address to pass along.
